title: 第013章 她要对谢亭渝做什么？
slug: 醉酒亲错人年下弟弟失控发疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“这点权限我还是有的。”

Lisa对自己的眼光有信心，三两句打消了舒楹的顾虑，“你不了解俪云内部的情况，谢总的风格不会计较这种小事。”

见她坚持，舒楹没有再继续抗拒。

高奢品牌热衷于各种晚宴，虽然是不对外开放的，但总少不了有内部人员往外发。

舒楹能撑场子的裙子不多，反正是A家的晚宴，Lisa直接借了她一条薄荷绿的吊带长裙，缎面的裙子质感极佳。

妆造团队也是蹭的品牌方今天为广告聘请的人，配合裙子的风格走的是清新的仙女风，见到她的人没有不夸的。

“我就说你很适合这条裙子。”Lisa眼前一亮，更加坚定了要提前买股的决心。

舒楹个人条件优越，不怎么挑妆造，反倒是她的脸能最大限度地衬托裙子和妆容。

“其实我想先锁定跟你合作，也是想看看你未来能走到什么地步。不管是你的个人账号，还是你的导演事业。”Lisa调整了下舒楹的肩带，少见地露出了一个微笑。

她比舒楹大十岁，人很瘦，酷爱极简的法式风，戴着链条眼镜乍一看很冷漠。

舒楹沉吟半晌点了点头，“谢谢，我会努力的。”

晚宴的举办地在一家老牌的商务酒店，离外滩有一段距离。

舒楹忧郁要跟言丛聊周末的拍摄，蹭了他的保姆车。

一回生二回熟，他们聊得很合拍。

抵达酒店前，言丛眼尖地发现了不远处蹲着几个私生粉。

这种私人行程正经粉丝没有渠道拿到，顶多是消息出来后跑来碰碰运气，但总有些神通广大的私生粉能提前买到地址。

言丛出道早，尝试过当演员，拍了一部电影一部电视剧就及时收手，转行当演员。

他不靠粉丝吃饭，谈恋爱也是坦坦荡荡的，是最不惯着私生粉的那类艺人，直接吩咐团队的人去把私生粉赶走了。

车内开着暖黄的光，看他皱眉跟经纪人说话的侧脸，恍然生出了点熟悉感。

很像两个消失前她在谢亭渝车上的场景。

言丛有四分之一的英格兰血统，长相英气，侧脸看鼻子的线条很优越。

有那么一瞬间她感觉看到了谢亭渝。

"I still have this authority."

Lisa was confident in her vision and dispelled Shu Ying's concerns with a few words, "You don't understand the internal situation of Liyun. Mr. Xie's style will not care about such trivial matters."

Seeing her persistence, Shu Ying did not resist any longer.

High-end luxury brands are keen on all kinds of dinner parties. Although they are not open to the public, there are always insiders who send them out.

Shu Ying didn't have many dresses that could hold up the occasion. Anyway, it was a dinner party at the A family, so Lisa directly lent her a mint green suspender skirt. The satin skirt was of excellent texture.

The makeup team was also hired by the brand for today's advertisement. She adopted a fresh fairy style to match the style of the skirt. Everyone who saw her praised her.

"I told you that this dress suits you very well." Lisa's eyes lit up, and she became more determined to buy stocks in advance.

Shu Ying has excellent personal conditions and is not very picky about makeup. On the contrary, her face can set off her skirt and makeup to the maximum extent.

"Actually, I want to lock in cooperation with you first, and I also want to see where you can go in the future. Whether it's your personal account or your director career." Lisa adjusted Shu Ying's shoulder strap and showed a rare smile.

She is ten years older than Shu Ying. She is very thin and loves minimalist French style. She looks cold at first glance when wearing chain glasses.

Shu Ying pondered for a while and nodded, "Thank you, I will try my best."

The dinner was held in an old business hotel, some distance away from the Bund.

Shu Ying was worried about talking to Yan Cong about the weekend shooting, so she took a ride in his nanny car.

They became acquainted once and twice, and they chatted in harmony.

Before arriving at the hotel, Yan Cong spotted a few bastard fans squatting not far away.

There is no way for serious fans to get this kind of private itinerary. At most, they come here to try their luck after the news comes out, but there are always some illegitimate fans with great powers who can buy the address in advance.

Yan Cong debuted early and tried to be an actor. After making a movie and a TV series, he stopped in time and changed his career to an actor.

He doesn't rely on his fans for a living, and he is open-minded when it comes to relationships. He is the type of artist who is the least accustomed to illegitimate fans. He directly orders his team to drive away the illegitimate fans.

There was a warm yellow light on inside the car, and looking at his frowning profile as he talked to his agent, he suddenly felt a little familiar.

It was very similar to the scene in Xie Tingyu's car before the two disappeared.

Yan Cong is a quarter of English descent, has a heroic appearance, and has a very good nose line when viewed from the side.

For a moment she felt like she saw Xie Tingyu.
